This just isn't a very accessible medium." - This is a complaint about the communication medium and asking about text alternatives. This could be A4 (Clarification Request) or just casual feedback.

Turn 20: "This is a verbal communication. I'm using my microphone." - The student is clarifying they're speaking aloud rather than typing.

Turn 24: "Go" - Another brief closing statement.
